node.name: start
node.description: start development services in the background.
node.whenToUse: you need the api, worker, or web app running in this checkout.
node.summary: start development services in the background

params.name: service
params.constraint: Limit to one or more services. Omit for all three: api, worker, web.

output.name: slot
output.constraint: Grove slot this checkout runs in (0 = source).

output.name: dependencies
output.constraint: What was done for local Neo4j and Supabase.

output.name: ready
output.constraint: Every requested service with a port answered its HTTP probe.

effects: Starts local Neo4j (docker compose) and Supabase when backend/.env points at localhost.
Spawns detached processes; pids and logs under .grove/run/.

node.name: stop
node.description: stop development services and release their listeners.
node.whenToUse: you are done with the services or need their ports back.
node.summary: stop development services and release their listeners

params.name: service
params.constraint: Limit to one or more services. Omit for all three: api, worker, web.

effects: Sends SIGTERM (then SIGKILL after 8s) to processes this CLI started. Leaves Neo4j and Supabase running; they are shared.

node.name: restart
node.whenToUse: a service is wedged or env changed and a watcher restart is not enough.

params.name: service
params.constraint: Limit to one or more services. Omit for all three: api, worker, web.

output.name: ready
output.constraint: Every requested service with a port answered its HTTP probe.

effects: Same as stop followed by start.

node.name: status
node.description: report each service: pid, port, listener, HTTP probe.
node.whenToUse: you need to know what is running before acting.
node.summary: report each service: pid, port, listener, HTTP probe

output.name: services
output.constraint: {service, pid, running, port, listening, http, log}.

node.name: logs
node.description: read recent log lines from a service.
node.whenToUse: a service misbehaves and you need its output.
node.summary: read recent log lines from a service

params.name: service
params.constraint: Limit to one or more services. Omit for all three: api, worker, web.

params.name: tail
params.constraint: Lines per service. Must be >= 1. Must be <= 5000.

node.name: logpath
node.whenToUse: you want to tail or open a log yourself.

params.name: service
params.constraint: Limit to one or more services. Omit for all three: api, worker, web.

node.name: doctor
node.description: check toolchain, env files, database reachability, and port ownership.
node.whenToUse: something will not start, or you are in a fresh checkout.
node.summary: check toolchain, env files, database reachability, and port ownership
effects: None. Read-only: probes sockets and reads files; changes nothing.

node.name: deps
node.description: install backend and web dependencies with pnpm.
node.whenToUse: a fresh checkout, a planted instance, or package.json changed.
node.summary: install backend and web dependencies with pnpm
effects: Runs `pnpm install` in backend/ and web/.

node.name: check
node.description: type-check the backend and run its unit tests.
node.whenToUse: before committing or reporting a backend change done.
node.summary: type-check the backend and run its unit tests

output.name: tests
output.constraint: ok, skipped, or the vitest output.

effects: None beyond compiler and test side effects.

node.name: db
node.description: the two databases: Neo4j (graph) and Supabase Postgres.
node.whenToUse: you need to reset, back up, restore, or regenerate types for a database.
node.summary: the two databases: Neo4j (graph) and Supabase Postgres
node.model: Neo4j holds the per-user knowledge graph; Supabase Postgres holds transcripts, embeddings, users, and the pg-boss queue. Both are shared across Grove instances on this machine.

children.name: neo4j
children.whenToUse: you need to initialise, wipe, back up, or restore graph data.

children.name: init-schema
children.whenToUse: a fresh database; the api also does this on boot.
effects: Creates Neo4j constraints and indexes; idempotent.

children.name: reset
children.whenToUse: you want an empty graph for a clean run.

params.name: force
params.constraint: Required when NEO4J_URI is not localhost.

effects: DESTRUCTIVE: wipes the graph named by backend/.env NEO4J_URI.

children.name: backup

output.name: output
output.constraint: Script output including the file written.

effects: Writes a JSON file under backend/backups/.

children.name: restore
children.description: load a backup file into the graph.
children.whenToUse: you need data back after a reset.
children.summary: load a backup file into the graph
effects: Writes nodes and relationships into the graph named by NEO4J_URI.

children.name: supabase
children.description: the local Supabase stack (Postgres, auth, REST) declared in backend/supabase/.
children.whenToUse: the api or worker cannot reach Postgres, or the schema changed.
children.summary: the local Supabase stack (Postgres, auth, REST) declared in backend/supabase/

children.name: start
children.whenToUse: backend/.env points at 127.0.0.1:54321 and nothing answers.
effects: Starts docker containers via `supabase start` in backend/.

children.name: stop
effects: Stops the containers; data volumes persist.

children.name: status
children.description: show local Supabase URLs and keys.
children.whenToUse: you need the local API URL or keys for .env.
children.summary: show local Supabase URLs and keys

children.name: types
children.description: regenerate database.types.ts for backend and web from the linked project.
children.summary: regenerate database.types.ts for backend and web from the linked project

node.name: query
node.description: run a Cypher query against the graph named by backend/.env.
node.whenToUse: you need to inspect graph data directly.
node.summary: run a Cypher query against the graph named by backend/.env
effects: Runs the statement as written; a write statement writes.
